name: last-uncomputable
title: The last uncomputable entry contradicts a test that already exists
description: Measured: the Pareto entry says no second objective is recorded, while the SSM reading carries two of them - a crash-free ratio and isolation refusals per request - computed from the same records and correlated per request, which the axes suite already asserts. What is genuinely missing is the frontier decision, which the module own threshold rule says belongs to whoever makes it
